name: env-manager
description: Safely inspect, plan, and manage registered project env files through a redacted local broker shared by AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Manage registered env files through a redacted local broker.
interface.longDescription: Adds a portable Agent Skill and local MCP broker for redacted inspection, group and variable structure, access classification, migration plans, N-way variable links, and opaque same-name value reuse across registered projects.
